entities.name: Helîm Yûsiv
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Helîm Yûsiv is a Syrian Kurdish writer and lawyer. He studied laws at the University of Aleppo and has published in Lebanon, Turkey and Germany. He writes in both Kurdish and Arabic languages.
